notes.title: Video Contest Announcement
notes.content:
Evil Defenders!

MacHellman needs you more than ever. Time to carry the flag of evil to the masses. Time to turn these greedy farmers away once and for all!

We announce a [b]contest for the best video[/b] of Evil Defenders! Win [b]exclusive merchandise[/b] from MacHellman!

[IMG]http://pics.crazypanda.ru/NK/lbe_526x277_videoContest_1.png[/IMG]

You can post links to your video here, and do not forget about the rules.


[h1]Rules[/h1]

CONTEST ENTRY
[list]
[*] Contest period starts at [b]12:00 PM Eastern (-4 GMT) on September 26[/b] and ends on [b]October 17 at 11:59 PM Eastern (-4 GMT)[/b].
[*] You need to create an interesting Evil Defenders gameplay video and download it on YouTube and “Videos” section in the Steam Community Hub. Submit your entry by posting a link to your video in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/412520/discussions/0/350542683207931360/]official contest thread[/url]. Do not forget to add your email, so we can contact you through it in case you win the contest!
[/list]
ENTRY REQUIREMENTS
[list]
[*] Your video has to be at least 1 minutes and at most 15 minutes long.
[*] Previously created videos that matched the rules, are also accepted.
[*] By entering the contest, you agree to not submit material which is copyrighted or against our rules and policies.
[*] By entering the contest, you agree that you are the author of the content/material that you are submitting.
[*] All text or voice additions to the footage have to be in the English language. At the same time, they cannot be taken from other published and copyrighted works.
[/list]
JUDGING
[list]
[*] Winners will be selected by the Evil Defenders team. All winners will be notified no later than October 21, 2016. A complete list of winners will be posted here on the Steam game page.
[*] There will be two nominations: Best video review (with voice additions) and Best gameplay (without voice additions).
[/list]
PRIZES
[list]
[*] A total of six prizes will be given. Each entrant may only win one prize — unique merchandise with MacHellman himself — coasters and cups.
[/list]
WINNER NOTIFICATION
[list]
[*] Winners will be notified by email no later than October 21, 2016 and requested to provide the appropriate winner's address. 
[*] Evil Defenders team will ship the prize via ground mail to the appropriate winner's address as provided.
[*] Prizes are non-transferable and must be accepted as awarded. Evil Defenders team is not responsible for a lost or damaged prize and in the case where the prize is lost or damaged it will not be replaced.
[/list]
RIGHTS 
[list]
[*] You will retain all rights to any video you submit — including ownership if applicable. By entering the contest, you grant the developers of Evil Defenders a royalty-free, nonexclusive right, in perpetuity, to use the video on the Internet.
[/list]

This epic battle begins on [b]11/11/2015[/b] at 11:00AM PST!

With six modes of difficulty and 90 levels across 15 distinct mission maps, an extensive skill tree to upgrade defensive towers, spells to repel enemy forces, you will find a ton of fun in this game!

Can't wait to see you all!
